description: A Java class implementing a mutable builder pattern for creating immutable Policy objects with a fluent API, including methods for setting, removing, and building policy entries with labels, subjects, resources, and permissions.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing a builder pattern for creating immutable Policy objects with methods for setting labels, subjects, resources, permissions, and building the final Policy.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new empty instance of ImmutablePolicyBuilder.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with a given PolicyId.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with a PolicyId and iterable of PolicyEntry objects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder based on an existing Policy object.

methods.name: forLabel
methods.description: Returns a LabelScoped object for a specific label.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the PolicyId for the builder.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle of the policy.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision of the policy.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds a PolicyEntry to the builder.

methods.name: setPolicyEntry
methods.description: Internal method to process and add a PolicyEntry.

methods.name: putAllSubjects
methods.description: Adds all subjects from a PolicyEntry.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple PolicyEntries at once.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry by label.

methods.name: removePolicyEntryFor
methods.description: Internal method to remove all data associated with a label.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes multiple PolicyEntries.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Sets subjects for a specific label.

methods.name: retrieveExistingSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the subject map for a label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a specific subject for a label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a subject for a label by issuer with ID.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a specific subject object for a label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Sets resources and permissions for a label.

methods.name: retrieveGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves or creates granted permissions map for a label.

methods.name: retrieveRevokedPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves or creates revoked permissions map for a label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Sets a single resource for a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource by key for a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource object for a label.

methods.name: setPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets permissions for a resource under a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets granted permissions for a resource.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets revoked permissions for a resource.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable Policy object based on current state.

methods.name: getAllLabels
methods.description: Collects all labels from subjects and permissions maps.

methods.name: getFinalSubjects
methods.description: Generates final Subjects object for a label.

methods.name: getFinalResources
methods.description: Generates final Resources object for a label.
